_comment: Item catalog. `image` names a dedicated assets/items/<image>.png (the real icon art, added 2026-09-09); `prop` (older, still supported) names an existing assets/props/<name>.png reused as a placeholder visual - kept only on the handful of quest-relic items that predate real item art. `width` calibrates size the same way props.json does. `keyItem: true` excludes an item from GameScene's random enemy-loot pool (see dropRandomLoot() in GameScene.cpp) - it can still be placed with api.spawnItem/giveItem, just never handed out at random. Everything without the flag is fair game for a random drop, so a new plot item MUST set it explicitly. `onUse` (added 2026-09-10, see GameScene::useItem()) picks what pressing Enter on an item in the inventory menu does: omit it (or set `{"type":"script"}`) to fire the onItemUsed(itemId) script entry point in whichever chapter is active - the right choice for anything narrative/quest-specific; set `{"type":"heal","amount":N}` or `{"type":"compass"}` to use a built-in, engine-handled effect that works identically in every chapter. `consumeOnUse: true/false` only applies to the built-in path (a script-dispatched item decides for itself whether/when to call api.removeItem).

glowing_acorn.name: Glowing Acorn
glowing_acorn.description: An acorn that never sprouted and never rotted either - it just sits in the palm of Lara's hand, faintly warm, faintly green.

root_seal.name: Root Seal
root_seal.description: A disc of hardened root, carved - not grown - with a spiral someone meant to be found.

deepstone_ember.name: Deepstone Ember
deepstone_ember.description: A coal-sized fragment of stone that glows from somewhere inside itself, with no fire anywhere nearby to explain it.

signal_core.name: Signal Core
signal_core.description: A small housing of old alloy, still drawing a slow pulse of current from a source that stopped existing generations ago.

cinder_charm.name: Cinder Charm
cinder_charm.description: A charm strung from a burnt cord. Whoever wore it didn't survive whatever burned Ashfall - but the charm itself is untouched.

iron_sword.name: Iron Sword
iron_sword.description: A plain, well-worn shortsword. Nothing special, and reliable for it.

wooden_staff.name: Wooden Staff
wooden_staff.description: A gnarled spellcaster's staff, undecorated but well-balanced.

hunting_bow.name: Hunting Bow
hunting_bow.description: A simple recurve bow, strung and ready.

round_shield.name: Round Shield
round_shield.description: A plain wooden shield with a worn metal rim.

leather_gloves.name: Leather Gloves
leather_gloves.description: A worn pair of leather gloves, broken in by someone else's hands first.

tech_gauntlet.name: Tech Gauntlet
tech_gauntlet.description: An armored glove etched with faint circuit lines. Warm to the touch, for no obvious reason.

spellbound_amulet.name: Spellbound Amulet
spellbound_amulet.description: A simple pendant on a cord, one bead glowing faintly for reasons nobody's written down.

cyber_visor.name: Cyber Visor
cyber_visor.description: A sleek eyepiece with a faint glow along one edge. Somebody built this to see something specific.

reinforced_boots.name: Reinforced Boots
reinforced_boots.description: Sturdy leather boots with light metal plating. Good for a long walk.

health_potion.name: Health Potion
health_potion.description: A corked vial glowing warm red. Tastes worse than it looks.

mana_potion.name: Mana Potion
mana_potion.description: A corked vial glowing cool blue.

antidote_vial.name: Antidote Vial
antidote_vial.description: A small green vial with a leaf-wrapped stopper.

stamina_draught.name: Stamina Draught
stamina_draught.description: An amber vial with a faint spark drifting inside.

dried_rations.name: Dried Rations
dried_rations.description: A small wrapped bundle of trail food, tied with twine.

honey_jar.name: Honey Jar
honey_jar.description: A small jar of faintly glowing honey.

bread_loaf.name: Bread Loaf
bread_loaf.description: A simple rustic loaf, still a little warm.

waterskin.name: Waterskin
waterskin.description: A leather water pouch with a wooden stopper.

berry_pouch.name: Berry Pouch
berry_pouch.description: A small cloth pouch, a few berries spilling from the top.

elixir_of_clarity.name: Elixir of Clarity
elixir_of_clarity.description: A slender pale vial with a slow inner swirl. Faintly humming, like everything else worth carrying.

gold_coin_pile.name: Gold Coin Pile
gold_coin_pile.description: A small stack of gold coins.

silver_coin_pouch.name: Silver Coin Pouch
silver_coin_pouch.description: A drawstring pouch with coins spilling slightly from the top.

gemstone_cluster.name: Gemstone Cluster
gemstone_cluster.description: A few small cut gemstones, grouped together.

ancient_coin.name: Ancient Coin
ancient_coin.description: A single large, worn coin engraved with unfamiliar script.

tech_chip.name: Tech Chip
tech_chip.description: A small square circuit chip with a faint internal glow.

ornate_ring.name: Ornate Ring
ornate_ring.description: A decorative ring with a small set stone.

jeweled_pendant.name: Jeweled Pendant
jeweled_pendant.description: A pendant on a chain with one prominent gem.

small_ingot.name: Small Ingot
small_ingot.description: A bar of raw, dull metal.

music_box.name: Music Box
music_box.description: A small ornate wind-up box, lid slightly ajar.

lockpick_set.name: Lockpick Set
lockpick_set.description: A small folding case of thin metal picks.

rope_coil.name: Rope Coil
rope_coil.description: A neatly coiled length of rope.

repair_kit.name: Repair Kit
repair_kit.description: A small open toolkit with basic tech tools inside.

herb_bundle.name: Herb Bundle
herb_bundle.description: A small bundle of tied dried herbs.

ore_chunk.name: Ore Chunk
ore_chunk.description: A raw chunk of unrefined ore.

cloth_bolt.name: Cloth Bolt
cloth_bolt.description: A rolled bolt of plain fabric.

nail_pouch.name: Nail Pouch
nail_pouch.description: A small pouch with a few nails and bolts spilling out.

spool_of_copper_wire.name: Spool of Copper Wire
spool_of_copper_wire.description: A wound spool of copper wire.

humming_crystal.name: Humming Crystal
humming_crystal.description: A small rough crystal with a faint internal pulse of light, in time with something Lara half-recognizes.

woven_talisman.name: Woven Talisman
woven_talisman.description: A small charm woven from plant fiber and thin wire together - nobody quite remembers who first thought to combine them.

old_key.name: Old Key
old_key.description: An ornate, tarnished key. Whatever it opens, it isn't nearby.

sealed_scroll.name: Sealed Scroll
sealed_scroll.description: A rolled parchment with a wax seal, unopened. Someone meant for this to wait.

broken_compass.name: Broken Compass
broken_compass.description: An old compass whose needle spins freely, pointing nowhere in particular - or everywhere at once.

memory_locket.name: Memory Locket
memory_locket.description: A small locket, closed, with a faint warm glow escaping the seam.

rootbound_charm.name: Rootbound Charm
rootbound_charm.description: A small carved wooden charm with a thin living root wrapped around it, still growing.

signal_fragment.name: Signal Fragment
signal_fragment.description: A jagged shard of circuitry that pulses gently, like a heartbeat that isn't quite Lara's own.

withering_petal.name: Withering Petal
withering_petal.description: A single flower petal that looks perpetually on the verge of wilting, never quite doing so.

sealed_vial_of_mist.name: Sealed Vial of Mist
sealed_vial_of_mist.description: A small glass vial containing slow-swirling grey mist. It hasn't settled in longer than it should take to settle.
